content_blocks.text: Treat **Creating Evenly Spaced Values with np.linspace()** as an explicit step in an array workflow. content_blocks.title: Guided walkthrough
content_blocks.text: `linspace` chooses the number of samples, not the increment. The example uses five samples from 0 through 1, including both endpoints.

common_mistakes.fix: Write every element before reading the result.

common_mistakes.problem: Using floating steps for exact counts
common_mistakes.why: Floating-point step sizes may not include endpoints as expected.
common_mistakes.fix: Use `linspace` when the sample count is the main requirement.
